originalAssessment.claim: Genuine independent app verification and build reuse checks support a local 101/102 recommendation. Full shipping/model execution remains incomplete.
originalAssessment.basis: Two distinct nonauthor reviewer results bind exact app base/head/current revisions and report hashes. Twenty actual app.ts builds and twenty-six reviewer PTY runs are retained, plus the changed101 PTY. Each reviewer built verdict parent/head twice per target before a verdict and current once afterward. Emitted outputs and literal source/bundle execution are genuine. Current target outputs equal corresponding repeated verdict outputs. Changed101 returns21 and invalidates the doubled-patch verdict. Local ceiling stops at missing103;104 cannot bypass it.
limits: No modeled one-at-a-time merge with fetched-back trunk inclusion and no actual watcher frontier state run beyond help. No live forge checks/mergeability/merge/CI/push/retarget/comments.
PR102 full prospective guidance was incomplete. Native parent spawn/followup envelopes are incomplete, so reviewer identities in task artifacts alone are not full callable worker proof.
Actual models unknown, no diversity. No transfer of the analogous Local verdict or previous placeholder builds.
Build output was deterministic within each target. Bun/node target marker differences are not observed random noise; missing noise and dev-server variants remain unrun.

publicationStatus: proposal-only; no canonical host evidence record is constructed
publicationGaps: This assessment format is not the canonical evidence schema. Root-relative operation bindings and any required structured method receipt require separate complete validation.
